text:
Barton Elementary School had 1 American Indian or Alaska Native student enrolled in 2025-26
One American Indian or Alaska Native student attended Barton Elementary School in the 2025-26 school year, maintaining the count from the previous year, data from the New York State Education Department shows.
Barton Elementary School had a total enrollment of 501 students during the 2025-26 school year. With 0.2% of enrollees identifying as American Indian or Alaska Native, this group was the school's smallest represented ethnicity.
The school, part of the Patchogue-Medford Union Free School District, is located in Patchogue, where the central office is based.
Within the district's 11 schools, Barton Elementary School reported the highest number of American Indian or Alaska Native students at that time.
New York ranks second nationwide in K-12 public education spending, with average current spending at $30,012 per student. This figure is nearly twice the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
